block.prompt:
Think about a job or profession that interests you — one you might want to do in the future, or one that someone in your family does.

Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) describing:
- what this job involves
- one way in which you think artificial intelligence could change or has already changed it
- whether you think this change is positive or negative, and why

Write in the first person and use an informal but clear register.
block.answer_key: Sample answer: My father is a radiologist — he examines medical scans to detect diseases. AI image-recognition software can now identify certain tumours in X-rays faster than a human eye. I think this is largely positive: it reduces diagnostic errors and frees doctors to spend more time with patients. However, it also raises questions about whether radiologists of the future will need different skills. I find that thought both exciting and slightly unsettling. (Auf Deutsch: Jede persönliche, kohärente Antwort in klar verständlichem Englisch mit einer begründeten Meinung ist akzeptabel. Beurteilung nach Kohärenz, Reichhaltigkeit des Ausdrucks und Texttreue zur Aufgabenstellung.)

levels: All three bullet points addressed specifically and coherently
Two bullet points addressed; one missing or very vague
One or zero bullet points addressed
Mostly accurate; varied vocabulary and sentence structure
Understandable with errors that do not affect meaning

watch_outs: Schüler:innen wählen häufig Jobs, über die sie wenig wissen, und verfallen in sehr allgemeine Aussagen. Ermutigen, einen konkreten, vertrauten Beruf zu wählen.
Häufiger Fehler: 'AI will take all jobs' als pauschale Aussage ohne Differenzierung — auf die Aufgabenstellung verweisen (eine spezifische Veränderung beschreiben).
